description: This file defines a Java interface named LogNode used for implementing customizable logging mechanisms. It specifies a method 'println' that logs messages with a priority, tag, message, and optional Throwable, facilitating the creation of a chain of log handlers or filters.

classes.name: LogNode
classes.description: An interface for a logging node in a chain, allowing custom log processing or filtering.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Logs a message with a specified priority, tag, optional message, and optional Throwable; intended to be implemented by classes to handle log output.
